# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth and Eve Reach Paradise's Gate

---

**19:1** And Seth and Eve came to the gate of paradise, and they saw there Michael the archangel standing and guarding the gate.

**19:2** And Seth asked Michael for the oil of mercy, saying: 'I beg you, give me the oil of mercy that I may anoint my father Adam who is sick and at the point of death.'

**19:3** And Michael answered Seth and said: 'I tell you truly, Seth, that I cannot give you what you ask, for it is not destined for you in this generation.'

**19:4** 'But when five thousand five hundred years have been fulfilled, then the Son of God, the most loving Christ, will come down to earth and resurrect the body of Adam and with him the bodies of the dead.'

**19:5** 'And then the Son of God will be baptized in Jordan, and when he comes out of the water, he will anoint all those who believe in him with the oil of mercy, and this oil of mercy shall be for those who are raised from the dead in his generation.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
